Fixed
Fixed
Delete/edit/templates/vm test/config commands now return errors and exit 1; empty lists no longer prefixed Error:
--node now filters the name/ID lookup on vm start/shutdown/delete/edit/clone; migrate --source does too
Requested --node is used when the template is available there (shared storage); otherwise existing fallback-with-warning kept for compatibility
Client WaitForTask now uses shared PollTask with backoff; vm/container waitForTask use WaitForTaskSuccess; unused constant removed

Decrypt returns ErrWrongKey instead of garbage; short base64-looking plaintext treated as plaintext; fingerprint compared and reported with fix command; enc:v1: prefix accepted on read (not yet written, for downgrade safety); SECURITY.md describes threat model. Keychain/per-install key left for future.
Estimates, max_disk=1 sentinel and RRD heuristic removed. Unknown usage is 0 in JSON and N/A in table/describe; --detailed and describe use QEMU guest agent get-fsinfo for real usage.

TLS verified by default (user decision). --insecure/--ca-cert global flags, PROX_INSECURE/PROX_CA_CERT, per-profile via config setup/create/update. Cert failures explain the fix. Fingerprint pinning not done.
Token auth via token ID (user@realm!name) as username and secret as password; works in profiles and PROX_* env vars with no new config fields. Docs and help updated.
Errors/warnings to stderr; shared output.StartSpinner writes to stderr and is skipped in quiet mode or when stderr isn't a terminal; profile migration notice to stderr.

CI uses go-version-file, adds golangci-lint v2.15.0 (.golangci.yml, 0 issues), govulncheck v1.9.0, go test -race, make build-all. Toolchain bumped to go1.27.4 (10 called stdlib vulns in go1.27.1/1.23 fixed).
Profile completion (config use, --profile); node completion for --node/--source/migrate target/node describe; name completion limited to first arg; clone gets VM completion.
vm shutdown/stop --force and ct stop --force use /status/stop. reboot/reset not added (split to feature if wanted).
401 -> one re-login and retry; ticket guarded by mutex; errors use Proxmox status reason + JSON message/errors, bodies truncated; node/upid/storage path segments escaped.

All items done across commits: ID check covers containers, migrate wording, vmFromResource, ambiguous names error, DeleteProfile pointer, atomic CreateProfile, profile name validation, setup messages + TTY prompts, config read masking, partial env warning, --disk help, mojibake, .gitignore.

Unit tests now cover template parsing, SSH keys, sshconfig (golden-style), crypto, profiles/TLS, client (httptest: auth, tokens, TLS, retry, errors, polling, fsinfo, force stop, escaping), util, tags, UPID parsing. sshconfig 83%, util 95%, config 41%, client 28%.

requestData[T] replaces 14 copies of request/decode boilerplate (same results and messages); removed dead code (GetVM, VirtualMachine.Config/Status, FirstRun, pkg/conversion, getStorageVolumeSize, unused constants); VM IP lookup trimmed to guest agent + cloud-init ipconfigN (old status/interfaces lookups hit non-existent fields/endpoints). N/A sentinel kept deliberately.
All task commands accept --wait/--no-wait (defaults unchanged, shown in help); global --timeout; Ctrl-C/timeout stop waiting with a prox logs --follow hint.
ct create --bridge/--ip/--gateway/--vlan (defaults give the old net0 exactly); storage default local-lvm if present else first active rootdir storage, falling back to local-lvm if the lookup fails.

Done: sshconfig package (Match/comments/globals preserved, insert after global section, atomic symlink-aware write + backup, Keyword=value parsing, IPv6 via net.ParseIP), OpenSSH host key defaults with --no-host-key-check opt-in, default User = local username. Not done: extractIPFromInterfaces still picks IPv4 only.
prox ssh --connect runs ssh directly; --print prints a shell-quoted ssh command (status to stderr). Neither touches ~/.ssh/config.

Global -o/--output table|json|yaml; --json kept as alias; status, config list, ct templates gained structured output; Info messages suppressed in structured mode; empty lists print []. 'wide' not implemented.
prox vm|ct snapshot list/create/rollback/delete (shared pkg/snapshot); --vmstate for VMs; confirmation on rollback/delete; wait flags; snapshot-name completion; JSON/YAML list.
--tag on vm start/shutdown and ct start/stop; lists targets, confirms (-y to skip), continues past failures and exits 1 if any failed. Delete by tag intentionally not added.
ct clone/migrate (--restart for running)/edit (hostname, cores, memory, --disk grow)/reboot, plus vm reboot. All with wait flags and completion.

ct templates --available lists aplinfo system templates; ct templates pull <os:version|name> downloads (node default first online, storage default local), skips if already present; JSON/YAML; wait flags.

prox vm create <name> --from <template>: clone + wait, cores/memory, ipconfig0 (dhcp or static+gw), ciuser, sshkeys (Proxmox URL encoding), disk grow, optional --start. Partial failure tells the user which VM to fix or delete.
prox ct enter (pct enter) and prox vm console (qm terminal) over SSH to the node; node address from /cluster/status with interface fallback; --host/--user/--port/--print.
GetTaskLog now pages through the whole log; verified against mock (120 lines) and unit tests
Confirm now errors when no answer can be read (exit 1, names the skip flag); delete/rollback/bulk resolve the target first and show ID/status/node. Piped 'y' still works.
Fixed; verified against mock
Fixed; verified against mock
describe reads config via tolerant ConfigNumber/ConfigFlag (numbers, numeric strings, enabled=1 property strings). Real PVE encoding not checked on a cluster, but both forms are handled.
MakeGroup helper on vm/ct/node/config/snapshot: unknown subcommand fails with suggestions; node list alias; prox --version
Fixed with tests; verified against mock. Note: vm edit --disk still prints its 'Updating configuration' summary after the resize (cosmetic).

tests/cli runs the real binary against internal/fakepve; 24 tests + 3 golden files; mutation-checked (reverting the logs fix fails 3 tests); -race clean; documented in docs/TESTING.md

All commands are RunE; packages return errors and no longer print them; Execute prints each failure once. Typed errors (apierr.ErrUnreachable/Auth/Permission/Certificate/NoConfig) pick the tip. Old output helpers (ClientError/UserError/VMError/ContainerError/APIError/AuthError/ConnectionError) deleted. CLI tests cover unreachable, bad login, 403, no config, and 'printed once'.

Info/Infoln go to stderr; vm/ct/node lists sorted (ID, name); list tables no longer start with a blank line; status uses the table renderer so long URLs fit; vm start/shutdown/delete name the VM and print 'Task started' plus one result line. Not done: --sort flag (not needed yet).

Client decodes into types (requestData[T], flexInt, requestOptionalTask); client.go 1647 -> ~1370 lines. IP/node-IP lookups return "" for unknown instead of the "N/A" sentinel (tables and JSON still render N/A, unchanged); GetIp's 'Error getting IP' string is gone. Untyped APIResponse deleted.

Lookup errors carry a kind (apierr.ErrNotFound/ErrAmbiguous); ssh stops on ambiguity, reports one combined not-found with suggestions from VMs and containers; ssh --delete skips the network when the alias is already in ~/.ssh/config. Mutation-checked.
ct describe lists NICs and mount points in numeric order (stable across runs) and labels state 'State'; node describe no longer repeats CPU/memory/disk/uptime. Mutation-checked.

config create refuses an incomplete profile (prompts on a terminal); config delete takes an optional profile, asks first (--force skips), and can remove the default profile. Unused config.Delete removed. CLI-tested.

Additive alignment done: -y/--yes on every prompt (--force still works); ct create --cpu/--id/--start; vm/ct clone take an optional new ID (next free); vm test hidden. Also fixed a real bug found by the new test: ct create --start could not find the just-created container because of the cached cluster listing. Wording ('requested') already covered by .12; stop-verb aliases already exist both ways.

Done: shared util.HasTag/ForEach (IP lookup pools 2x65 lines -> one helper), cmdutil.WaitForTask and FinishTask (task ending was 12 copies), lookup package (one finder for VMs and containers, one ID-free check), node uses util formatters, ssh uses cmdutil.RunSSH, 19 unused wrapper functions removed. pkg+cmd net -246 lines. List struct/table and profile-parser duplication moved to a new P4 issue.

Removed 520 lines of unused code: client validation.go/network.go/types_extended.go, GetClusterStatus/IsVMRunning/IsContainerRunning/WaitForTask (and their interface entries), NewClient, ClearClientCache, 13 constants, VirtualMachineOption and an unused variadic param, VirtualMachine.GetDiskInfo. NOT done: moving pkg/ to internal/ (would break external importers; left as a decision for the owner).

Execute() creates one signal context (SetContext + ExecuteC); 25+ functions now take ctx from cmd.Context() instead of context.Background(), so Ctrl-C cancels any in-flight request (exit 130, 'Interrupted'); a second Ctrl-C ends the process; --wait keeps its 'stopped waiting; the task is still running' message. Real-SIGINT CLI tests, mutation-checked. Also removed the shared username/password/url package vars in cmd/config. NOT done: the flag-derived globals (output.QuietMode/format, client TLS overrides and wait timeout, config.profileOverride) remain; they are set once per process from flags and replacing them means threading a settings struct through every package for little gain.
